title: refactor(rest): computeExecCtx calls the one request-to-ExecutionContext composition, resolveRequestExecutionContext
body:
Part of #23217

Clause-②: no
Ruling-ref: 6227928430

Slice 2 of #23217 under ruling record 6227928430 (letter A): REST's door, `RestServer#computeExecCtx` in `packages/rest/src/rest-server.ts`, calls the one `resolveRequestExecutionContext` that slice 1 landed in `@objectstack/core` (`f5ef054a7`). #23217 remains open for three doors (`service-settings`, `service-storage`, `plugin-hono-server`), each a later slice. No export moves and there is no app-author surface.

## What changed

- **`computeExecCtx`** keeps what is this door's own and calls the function once. 192 lines out, 90 in. What stays at the door, in its old order: the environment and auth-service resolution with the `if (!authService) return undefined` early return, the header normalisation (append per array element), the engine through `wiredEngineOrLoud` (the kernel branch still absorbs), the tenancy wiring (now a thunk: the kernel's `getServiceAsync('tenancy')`, else `tenancyServiceProvider`, else none), then `__kernel`, `__authEnvironmentId`, the `Server-Timing` disclosure, the memo in `resolveExecCtx`, and the fail-closed `catch` with its `apiKeyLifecycleRefusals` side channel.
- **REST's named parameters**, each measured against the hand-written code on `f5ef054a7` before it was replaced (slice 1's handover, confirmed row by row):

| parameter | REST passes | what the hand-written code did |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `anonymous` | `'fail-closed'` | `if (!authz.userId) return undefined` and `assembleExecutionContext` |
| `authGate` | `'reread-when-active'` | a key: `authz.authGate`. A session: re-read only while `isAuthGateActive()`; a throwing probe reads as inactive; a failed re-read is `AuthzStoreUnavailableError('auth_gate')` |
| `credentials` | `'api-key-and-session'` | `headers` and `getSession` both handed to `resolveAuthzContext` |
| `sessionApi` | `'required'` | `if (!api?.getSession) return undefined`, the API-key door included |
| `session` | `'request'` | `api.getSession(inProcessSessionReadInput(headers))`, a throw read as no session |
| `tenancy` | the thunk above | `classifyAdmissionTenancyPosture` on the same two wirings |
| `localization` | `{ settings: () => provider ? seamOrUndefined(provider(env)) : undefined }` | the same lookup, then `resolveLocalizationContext` |
| `requestLocale` | `this.extractLocale(req)` | the same parse, at assembly |
| `accessToken` | `'withhold'` | `accessToken: undefined` |
| `oauth` / `onAdmission` | `undefined` / `undefined` | none |

- **The readers move with the call.**
  - `scripts/check-single-authz-resolver.mjs`: the rest row of `DELEGATORS` now names `resolveRequestExecutionContext`. Left on `resolveAuthzContext`, check (2) would pass on the five prose mentions of it that remain in the file.
  - `packages/core/src/security/authz-store-unavailable.test.ts`: `rest-server.ts` no longer calls `resolveAuthzContext({`, so its ledger row goes (the set-equality audit requires it). The scanner's positive control now names the composition's file.
  - `packages/rest/src/execctx-authz-input-seam-reachability.test.ts` §0 and `auth-gate-allowlist-fault-window.measurement.test.ts`'s structural pin read source text inside `computeExecCtx`. They are re-aimed in place, with the superseded pins quoted, as those files ask. Each still holds its subject: both tenancy wirings reach the classification, the tenancy region holds no `catch`, the door declares `'reread-when-active'` and keeps no second copy of the gate decision, and the call hands over no path. The decision's own window is pinned in core's `request-execution-context.test.ts` (choice 2). The behavioural drives in both files are unchanged and green.
  - `packages/runtime/src/security/request-execution-context.conformance.test.ts` (ruling item 4) gains REST as a row. It drives `RestServer.resolvePackageRouteExecutionContext` on the single-kernel wiring and sets aside `__kernel` and `__authEnvironmentId` by name (both asserted absent on this wiring). It has a new request that tells `'resolved'` from `'reread-when-active'` (the gated session while no gate is active) and a REST CONTROL case. Who a request resolves to is now derived from the row's declared `sessionApi`: REST authenticates nobody on a host with no auth service, while the runtime door admits the key there.
- **The ruling's one ADR-0096 / ADR-0069 pin** is in `packages/rest/src/rest-exec-ctx-principal-kind.test.ts`. It is a six-row table driven through the real `GET /api/v1/data/:object` route and read at the protocol:
  - no credential gets `401` with exactly `ANONYMOUS_DENY_BODY`, and `findData` is never called;
  - a held session while a gate is active gets `403` with its code and message, and the engine is never asked;
  - the same session while no gate is active is admitted as `member1`, with no `authGate` on the envelope;
  - an API key beside the held cookie answers for its own owner;
  - an active gate whose re-read fails gets `503 SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE`, and the engine is never asked;
  - CONTROL: an ungated session is admitted.
- **Changeset:** `patch` on `@objectstack/rest` (`.changeset/23217-s2-rest-door.md`). The published `rest-server` code changes, and the one ordering note below is a fact a reader of the package can meet.

## Evidence (head `5acdd53a9`)

- **Merge of `main` at `fb6fb24e2`** (merge commit `5acdd53a9`; no rebase, amend or force-push). One conflicted hunk: the import block of `rest-server.ts` (about :220). Main (#23050 slice 13c) dropped the `metaSaveRequestOptions` import, and this branch dropped `AuthSessionApi` from the contracts type import. It was resolved to main's two comment lines and `import type { ISecurityService } from '@objectstack/spec/contracts';`. Neither symbol is used as code in the merged file; the only mention left is that comment. The merged file differs from main by exactly this slice's 284 changed lines, and the PR still touches the same 8 files. Census counts in `rest-server.ts`, main / merge: `resolveExecCtx` 55 / 55, `enforceAuth` 40 / 40, `seamOrUndefined` 11 / 11, `wiredEngineOrLoud` 11 / 11. Re-measured on the merge, after rebuilding the closure:
  - `@objectstack/rest` typecheck exit 0 (test layer 0 / 0);
  - ESLint `--no-inline-config` on `rest-server.ts` exit 0;
  - the REST full local project: `Test Files 295 passed (295)`, `Tests 6042 passed | 326 skipped (6368)`, which includes this slice's pins, the censuses and the `meta-disabled-package-doors.test.ts` file main brought;
  - conformance `Tests 9 passed (9)` and the core ledger `Tests 39 passed (39)`;
  - gates: 87 derived, 86 run with exit 0, and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` NOT MEASURED (exit 3), reconciled `0 UNRUN`.
  The readings below were taken on the pre-merge head `96f05115f`.
- **Before / after.** The pin was committed first, on the hand-written door (`865e7d135`): `Tests 20 passed (20)`. On the converted door it is green again, inside the full suite.
- **REST, full local project, under the verify lock:** `Test Files 294 passed (294)`, `Tests 6036 passed | 326 skipped (6362)`, `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- **Targeted REST families** (execctx, tenancy posture, API-key lifecycle and account posture, auth gate, direct mounts, in-process session read, memo, censuses), at `e6e916a00` (same code): `Test Files 21 passed (21)`, `Tests 330 passed (330)`.
- **Conformance:** `Tests 9 passed (9)` (two rows, six requests, two CONTROLs). Core repo-project ledger: `Tests 39 passed (39)` (40 before, minus the rest row).
- **Typecheck:** `@objectstack/rest` exit 0 (test layer 0 / 0), `@objectstack/core` exit 0 (4 files / 4 errors held), `@objectstack/runtime` exit 0 (27 files / 190 errors held). All three debt ledgers are unchanged.
- **Ablation, one-off.** Direction declared before running: RED. `authGate: 'reread-when-active'` became `'withhold'` via `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor 1 to 0, blob `4aec26e3a6c4` to `8f9ccb644aee`, marker count 1). REST gate pins: `Tests 21 failed | 61 passed (82)` over 5 of 6 files. The red pins include the new pin's 403 and 503 rows, `#7280`'s end-to-end 403, both direct-mount HELD cases and the OUTAGE case, seam §4's POSITIVE CONTROL and its 503, and the key-posture pins. `rest-auth-gate.test.ts` stays green; it hand-builds its contexts. Conformance: `Tests 2 failed | 7 passed (9)` (the session row and the REST CONTROL). Restore: `blob == HEAD (4aec26e3a6c4) and git diff HEAD is empty`, marker 0. Observed direction = declared direction.
- **Census terms held:** `resolveExecCtx` stays at 55 and `enforceAuth` at 40 in `rest-server.ts`. These are the bare-term counts `execctx-consumer-census.test.ts` and the dogfood `authz-probe-blind-spot.census.ts` pin; the dogfood one does not run on PRs. `seamOrUndefined` stays at 11 and `wiredEngineOrLoud` at 10.
- **The composition's distinctive code lines** in `rest-server.ts`, base to head: `resolveAuthzContext({` 1 to 0, `classifyAdmissionTenancyPosture(` 2 to 0, `assembleExecutionContext(` 1 to 0, `resolveLocalizationContext(` 1 to 0, `inProcessSessionReadInput(` 2 to 0, `normalizeAuthGate(` 1 to 0. `isAuthGateActive(` goes 3 to 1, and the one left is a line of the gate table in a comment.
- ESLint `--no-inline-config` over the 7 changed `.ts` / `.mjs` files: exit 0, no output.

## Acceptance notes

- **One ordering moved, measured.** The door resolves the engine before the composition asks the auth service for its session read; before, it asked first. A scratch probe (not committed) drove `resolvePackageRouteExecutionContext` on both trees. Five of seven readings are identical. The two that differ are double faults on the single-kernel wiring: the configured engine provider fails AND the auth service exposes no session read (or its `getApi()` rejects). Those answered `401` (no context) and now answer `503 SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE`, the engine outage. With a working auth service the engine outage was already `503`, so the new answer no longer depends on the auth service's state. The kernel branch absorbs an engine failure, so it is unaffected. Production compositions build the auth service from plugin-auth, whose `getApi()` always yields a session read. Keeping the old order byte for byte needs either a second copy of the session-API check at the door, which letter A item 3 forbids, or a lazy `ql` input on the function, which is a change to slice 1's export and outside this slice. The changeset states the window.
- **`extractLocale(req)`** is now evaluated at the call, before the reads, instead of at assembly. It is a pure parse of the headers and `?locale` that cannot throw for a request that passed the header check, so no answer moves.
- **Files outside the claim's named surface**, for the seat to declare: `packages/rest/src/execctx-authz-input-seam-reachability.test.ts` and `packages/rest/src/auth-gate-allowlist-fault-window.measurement.test.ts`. Both are REST source-text pins on `computeExecCtx`'s body, re-aimed in place.
- Local gates: 88 derived, 87 run, all exit 0; `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exited 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET: it needs a whole-tree build), so it is NOT MEASURED locally and CI runs it. `test:repo` is CI's.
